description: This file defines the 'Documents' class for managing document records within the vtiger CRM system. It extends CRMEntity and provides methods for handling file uploads, database interactions, report generation, export, and relationship management related to documents/notes.

classes.name: Documents
classes.description: Represents document records and their management within the vtiger CRM system, including file handling, database operations, relationship management, and report/export functionalities.

methods.name: save_module
methods.description: Handles the saving/updating of a document record, including uploading files and updating database entries.

methods.name: insertIntoAttachment
methods.description: Uploads file attachments and links them to a document record.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Generates an SQL query for exporting document data in CSV format.

methods.name: del_create_def_folder
methods.description: Ensures default attachment folder exists if no folder is assigned.

methods.name: generateReportsQuery
methods.description: Constructs the primary SQL query for document-related reports.

methods.name: generateReportsSecQuery
methods.description: Constructs the secondary SQL query for related modules in report generation.

methods.name: setRelationTables
methods.description: Returns relation tables for linked modules.

methods.name: unlinkDependencies
methods.description: Removes dependencies (like relations) before deleting or archiving.

methods.name: unlinkRelationship
methods.description: Removes a relationship between a document and another module record.

methods.name: getFileTypeFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the database field name for the file type.

methods.name: getFile_FieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the database field name for the filename/upload.

methods.name: isFolderPresent
methods.description: Checks if a folder with given ID exists.

methods.name: restore
methods.description: Restores a document record, re-linking folder relationships if missing.

methods.name: getQueryByModuleField
methods.description: Modifies a query based on module and field parameters, especially for MailManager integration.
